What happened
The system tried to post a vendor invoice but could not find the correct account assignment for your company code and tax code combination. No GL account has been mapped for input tax (MWS condition type) in company code 0001.
What to do — 3 steps
  1. Navigate to SPRO → Financial Accounting → Tax on Purchases/Sales → Posting → Define Tax Accounts
  2. Check key 0001 / KDV2 / MWS and assign the correct input tax GL account
  3. Re-post the original invoice document in MIRO or FB60
